headline: Gold Prices Decline as Rising Oil Prices Fuel Inflation and Rate Hike Concerns
summary: Gold prices fell for consecutive sessions as elevated oil prices intensified inflation concerns and added uncertainty to the Federal Reserve's future interest rate path.
why: Precious metals like gold are sensitive to energy-driven inflation metrics and interest rate expectations, as higher yields increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Rising energy costs fuel inflation fears, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy that pressures non-yielding gold.

why_moved: Gold prices dropped because surging oil prices heightened inflation worries, leading traders to price in a more aggressive Federal Reserve rate outlook.
